reviews.review: Battle brother, you must slay the invading Chaos forces, FOR THE EMPRAH!

An excellent hack and slash type of game for those of us who like the genre. The game itself is pretty well made, the graphics are good and the soundtrack leaves little to be desired, while the gameplay itself is pretty smooth and easy too master. there are some really nice animations for executions and such, but to be honest, there could have been a few more. The game itself also has a few bugs that do affect gameplay. The one I encountered specifically was getting stuck between the props. I had to restart my checkpoint to get rid of it. 
The storyline however, is OK. There is much to be desired and the whole thing is really just good army experience. If I had to have say what I missed in it, I would have said that the whole thing is a bit too simple. There was so much space for complexity in the story that was avoided. Perhaps that was for the best though because the campaign was incredibly short. It would have been nice to fight more factions. And it would also have been nice to fight as different factions too.

I did not play the online.

This is more like Dawn of War 3 Preliminary Edition.  The game mechanics have totally changed to FPS with very little to no team management.  But it has great graphics and a cool environment.  The previous editions were about battle planning, spacing and tactics on a third person environment.  This one  has nice PS3 like  graphics and with much less demanding combat- just shoot.  And no real skill mgmt or weapon mgmt.

If the series continued, it could have been improved for complexity, but THQ is over now, so God knows.

Its a tough call reall. If you like the 40k universe its a solid but repetetive game that actually goes on for a bit to long. It was enjoyable but not much variety. During the last few lvls i kept thinking. Isnt this done yet? There are a limited set of enemies Orcs & Chaos+Renegade Guard and a few incarnations of each. 

Ive been dipping my toes into the multiplayer experience and i guess theres where the replay value is. Havent bought any dlc so cant comment if that raises the experience. 

Its good but not great.
